games.title: Avatar: Rise of the Phoenix King
games.notes: Easter egg: On either the title screen or the game over screen, type 'ozai' to switch characters and play the next game as Ozai. Type 'aang' on one of those screens to switch back to Aang.
games.originalDescription:
The Avatar World’s fate will be decided with a fight between Aang and the Fire Lord Ozai. Play the Rise of the Phoenix King game to become the hero of the four nations! The ruler may seem impossible to beat, but everything is possible if you work hard enough!

You can control the Air Bender and use his attacks to your liking. Take part in the ultimate battle and defeat the malicious leader once and for all! Fight as much as you can so your results will be remembered in the score list.

Learn how to guide your warrior!
Controlling your character is quite simple. Use A and D buttons to move left or right on the pillars, and W and S to make Aang jump and duck to avoid enemy’s attacks.

To defeat Lord Ozai, you have to send powerful airwaves his way. You can do so by holding down the Left click and sliding it towards the leader for a normal attack. For the blast attack, you should do the same, but draw a loop with your mouse in the process and aim for the target. The attacks can also be used as a defense, as they cancel Ozai’s fires when reaching them.

The game consists of multiple fights between the two benders. It takes three hits for Aang to lose a battle, and, unfortunately, they will not restore after each level. Thus, it’s all about fighting as much as you can. The Lord, on the other hand, has three lives at first, but he gets harder and harder to beat as you advance in stages.

Use the pillars to your advantage!
The columns can act as a shield for the fire strikes. Thus, they take damage as well, and it takes three regular attacks from Aang to destroy a piece, while it requires only two from Ozai. The blast waves don’t affect the poles at all. Moreover, you can’t jump on each other’s set of pillars.

Achieve the highest score you can! One successful attack gives you 50 points. Finishing stages can also raise your results, with two hundred units at first. This number will gradually increase with each level.

Even though you keep winning, Lord Ozai will keep saying that you’re weak, and he will always return. Don’t get discouraged! Just prepare for the harder circumstances you will have to face in combat.

Continue your fight with the malicious ruler, or else the Avatar World is doomed!

games.title: Phoenix Yeah Wright 1
games.originalDescription:
(warning, Phoenix Wright 3 spoilers in the movie)

Well, while looking around for any rival Phoenix Wright parody movies, I saw one who tried to do a Phoenix Wright game in flash, giving me the super original and creative "hey, I can do that!" idea to. Wow, where do I get my ideas.

Originally I had another sketch show in mind, but that's getting kinda old anyway, so trying something whole diffrent here.
I had a lot more ideas, there would be 2 court cases and something always skipped in PW parodies, the investigation scene.
However, halfway trough making this I realised I should really redo the whole screen layout with the courtrecord on screen all the times and a more solid text interface, so I can remove typo's more easely and all.
Ah well.

Finished this one so I can see if my general ideas are good tough. Not sure if you people dig it, since jokes need a lot more time to build up now, so this movie's rather slow, untill the end anyway.
If it's a succes, I can start on the investigation part and the real courtcase. It's fun to do a project that doens't involve voice acting for a change.
Well there's a little bit voice acting still tough. Thanks to Silver Sister and Ferry for helping out, and Ultra the hedgehog for help with action script.

By the way, the final 2 choices in the game don't matter, so there's no extra or wrong ending, just so you know.
And this game should be painfully easy, so I doubt I need to put a walktrough down here, right? ^^;

Phoenix Wright concept and characters by Capcom.

games.title: Phoenix Yeah Wright 2 Pt.1
games.originalDescription:
Started on the sequel to Phoenix yeah Wright game, but seems I have to shelve it again because I have a lot of other pressing projects to finish first again, d' oh.

So I figured, since I finished the prologue chapter anyway, might as well throw it up here, both to see how the sound works, cause that always seems to work randomly, and to check if I should change the way I handled this game before going to tackle the real case.

So feel free to fire off any suggestions, tough I suppose sound sync and spelling will always remian a problem with me ^^;
It least it's a huge improvement over the first game, faster, more smooth, and there's even the investigation bits from the games represented too. yay.

So still have a lot to think about, about how to fix this stuff.
Ah well, that's for over a month then.

Thanks for voices to Silversister and Ferry, music's from the official orchestral/jazz/Cadenza albums of Phoenix Wright.

Oh, and in case people will bother me about it all the time, the solutions:
To get out of the witness testemony, press the second statement, then present the restaurant menu at the third, new statement.

As for the investigation, click on the blue flyer on the corner, select it again, then click closeby the cash registers to enter the kitchen. Then click on the grills, and finally on one of the tables to beat the game.
tough make sure to talk to Gumshoe first, talking while carrying kitchen utensils is fun.
ugh, I really have to redraw detective Gumshoe when I continue..

games.title: Phoenix Yeah Wright 2 pt.2
games.originalDescription:
Picking right up where https://rogerregorroger.deviantart.com/art/Phoenix-yeah-Wright-2-Pt-1-115831738 left of.

***
Edit: Phew, I did find a quite recent back up after all, so I fixed it up, the movie ends now before the trial, so there's less material, but at least a more solid ending.
Also, I added arrows to where you can move to a new area.
***

Well, this is the end. As stated before in my journal, Flash got extremely slow whenever I opened the actionscript menu, so I had to make seperate fla files to save the actionscript in and OFCOURSE I just had to save one right on top of the mother file, erasing everything. Whee.

And frankly, I was getting sick of programming anyway, no words, or movies of me punching computers to dust can express how much I hate programming, it's so random and unstable and arghhh.

Dunno if I will ever continue this project, shame that most jokes and payoffs are still yet to come, but I lost over 30 hours of work since the last backup (well, 30 hours of reading a book while waiting for the computer to load 2 lines of script mostly) and I lost my patience over the programming months ago, so I'm not in the mood anyway.
Maybe when I have a shiny new computer in the distant future, for now, game over.

The first password doesn't work, the text in the preloader are missing for some reason, sounds are all messed up, the background 3d effect when pressing and presenting evidence doens't seem to load and pressing a statement in the testemony sends the movie into oblivion. So that's as far as I got. Funny how programming even get's regular animation all $#(*ed up even tough they aren't invovled.
Have fun or something.

Which means I'm back to Kingdom hearts, tough with maybe a Crisis Core break inbetween.

People in this world use the art of words instead of war

CONTROLS:
W, A, S, D (or arrows) - moving
A, S, D, F (or H, J, K, L) - fighting
SPACE - talking to people, skipping dialogs, skipping enemies' move
ESC - leaving the battle
DESCRIPTION:
Imagine a world without violence. No weapons, no murder. That's the world you live in. In this world when people have problems, they use the art of words instead of war.
Relaxing outside is the usual daily routine for you. But this day is not a usual one. Today brings problems, and in this world there's only one way to solve it.

We wanted to make this game for Ludum Dare 32, but we did some wrong game design decisions and failed. Anyway, we think that the game is not bad and we really hope you'll enjoy it. Speсial thanks to iRapter and WolveGames.

FULL-ASS FANGAME OF FRIDAY NIGHT FUNKIN'
REMADE IN UNITY ENGINE!

What originated as a mini-project born out of university/covid induced boredom has rapidly matured into a more serious project. Despite the limited time constraints due to studies that led to two years of on-and-off work, I am thrilled to announce the completion of FNF' Reimagined 1.0 - The Week 1 Update!

The game is 400MB - if you have bad internet and the game takes forever to load, consider downloading.

早いものでもう今月最後の更新ですね。

さてさて、現在制作中の新シリーズ「キャンディ・ルームズ」ですが、作業は大詰めを迎えています。

ゲーム部分はほぼ完成しているのですが、シリーズ初回ということでサウンドなども一から入れないといけなかったりと、まだ細かい所がいろいろ残っています。

今回はファンキーランド初の脱出ゲームということで、いつもと雰囲気を変えてみましたが、こういうのも気に入っていただけるとうれしいなと思います。

おそらく今週末までには公開できると思いますので、楽しみにお待ちください。

そして、女の子向けミニゲーム第２弾は「フルプリ・コーデ」という着せ替えゲームを予定していますので、こちらもお楽しみに。

では、また来月！

games.originalDescription:
皆さま、お久しぶりです！
１月に「セブンディファレンス」が終了してから４ヶ月以上経ってしまいましたが、ようやく新コーナーのスタートです！

今回からスタートする「水曜日の間違い探し」ですが、その名のとおり、毎週水曜日の更新となります。
前回の「セブンディファレンス」と比べると

・探す間違いは７個→５個に
・更新が７のつく日の月３回→毎週水曜日に
・画像が横並び→縦並びで写真が大きく！

なっています。
これから毎週更新ということで大変ですが、何とか頑張っていきたいと思いますので、よろしくお願いします。

それにともなって、去年はほぼ毎週脱出ゲームを公開していましたが、今後しばらくは「フルーツキッチン」→「ガールズルーム」→「リリースお休み」といった感じで、２週公開１週休みというスケジュールにさせていただきたいと思いますので、よろしくお願いします。

それから、６月８日にファンキーランドは11周年を迎えることができました！
周年記念といえば毎年プレゼント企画や記念ゲームを作ったりしていましたが、去年10周年という節目も終えて、ご覧のとおり通常の更新作業だけで既に私のキャパを超えてしまっておりますので（汗）、今年の周年イベントは特に行わないということでご了承いただければと思います。

それでは、これからもファンキーランドをよろしくお願いします！
